<function name="ValueChanged" parent="DProperty_Generic" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Called by this control, or a derived control, to alert the row of the change.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="newVal" type="any">The new value.</arg>
		<arg name="force" type="boolean">Force an update.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
